test_get_token_by_name: test the _get_token_by_name function to retrieve a stored token by its name
test_save_token: test the _save_token function to store a new token or overwrite an existing one
test_set_active_token: test the _set_active_token function to set a stored token as the active token
test_login: test the _login function to authenticate and save a token with its display name
test_logout: test the logout function to delete all tokens or remove a specific named token
